feeds.title: It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
feeds.description: I'm Sam Turnbull, a vegan recipe blogger, cookbook author, and YouTuber writing to you from Toronto, Canada. I bring you the best Easy Vegan Recipes to satisfy all your cravings that use easy-to-find ingredients, to make cooking plant-based a breeze!

feeds.title: Running on Real Food
feeds.description: A vegan food blog that focuses on simple, healthy plant-based recipes anyone will love. You'll also find a wealth of free workouts and articles on health, wellness, and nutrition.

feeds.title: The First Mess
feeds.description: Vegan food blog with beautiful photography and healthy, seasonal recipes. Run by Laura Wright. The First Mess is all about cooking with natural, whole, plant-based foods, eating seasonally, and sharing wholesome meals.

feeds.title: Okonomi Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa! I'm the voice, photographer, and recipe developer behind Okonomi Kitchen. The blog is a bit of everything, but mostly feel good recipes inspired by whole foods - always plant based and usually gluten, oil & refined sugar free. Naturally, I LOVE Japanese and ethnic food so you'll probably find a lot of recipes from Japanese cuisine and other cuisines around the world.

feeds.title: Dreena Burton
feeds.description: Dreena Burton is the OG vegan cookbook author, publishing her first title in 2001. She began her plant-kind life over 25 years ago. Dreena also shares her passion and care in her recipes. Every one of Dreena's recipes includes notes to help guide the home cook, to become more familiar with plant-based foods and techniques, and to make substitutions.

feeds.title: Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: My name is Rose - just an ordinary girl born in South Korea and raised in the beautiful country of Canada. Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog is for people who are cheap, lazy, and interested in the vegan lifestyle. Covers easy and affordable vegan meal ideas, low-calorie vegan recipes, Korean recipes, Asian recipes, vegan snacks, and vegan breakfast.

feeds.title: Veganlovlie
feeds.description: Vegan recipes, fusion Mauritian recipes, all things crafty & lovely. Created by Teenuja Dahari & Kevin Mangaroo, the couple behind the Veganlovlie blog who love to immortalize vegan recipes into delicious photos and make tempting recipe videos.

feeds.title: The Viet Vegan
feeds.description: The Viet Veganis a personal food blog by Lisa Le. Search for a delicious recipe. Explore Vietnamese, Gluten-free,Vegan recipes. My name is Lisa, I'm in my 30s, and I like taking pictures of food. I've been vegan since October 2013 and before that, I was vegetarian. While I no longer advocate cooking with dairy and eggs, I know that there are some people who have loved using the recipes on here.

feeds.title: Planted and Picked
feeds.description: Welcome to Planted and Picked! We are Sandra and Scott and we strive to share plant-based recipes, resources, and ideas to help you improve your health and the health of the planet, one meal at a time. Whether you are vegan, vegetarian, or veg-curious, we are excited that you have joined us and hope that you will take a seat at our table.

feeds.title: Hot for Food
feeds.description: Easy recipes to level up your vegan meals. Lauren Toyota breaking all the misconceptions of what it means to be vegan one drool-worthy recipe at a time.
